info.title: ACNH Power Pockets
info.author: chatelp
info.description: On-console pocket and Bells editor for Animal Crossing: New Horizons 3.0.x
info.details:
Edits the pocket slots (20, 30 or 40, as many as you have unlocked), Bells, Nook Miles and the house loan of the primary resident, directly on the console. Fork of ACNH Save Editor by cbreezy210: the save engine is his, the interface is new.

- Pick an item once, then each press of Y drops it in the next empty slot. Occupied slots are never overwritten.
- Every change is staged and shown in a Review screen (before > after); nothing is written until you press Apply.
- Quantities stop at each item's real stack limit; about 10,500 items that never stack are marked 1/slot.
- 69 built-in favorites, plus your own, managed in the app.
- Catalog: search by name or hex ID, browse 113 collections (styles such as Japanese, furniture series, HHA themes, clothing styles and themes) and filter by type with ZL / ZR.
- Turnips panel: this week's Stalk Market prices, read from the save (read-only).
- Integrity hashes recomputed and checked before every write; SD backups before every write and a pre-edit backup.

WARNING: this app writes to your save. Back up your save with JKSV or Checkpoint first, and use it offline. Launch it by holding R while starting Animal Crossing (title override), not from the Album.

Item data from NHSE (GPL-3.0). Collections from the community ACNH data spreadsheet, via Norviah/animal-crossing (MIT). Font Varela Round (OFL 1.1).

changelog:

1.1.1 - L / R wrap around the panels; 41 built-in favorites.
1.1.0 - Turnips panel: this week's Stalk Market prices, read-only.
